description: Repository class for managing WrongAssignmentReport entities, including creation, existence check, retrieval, and status updates, using Prisma ORM.

classes.name: WrongAssignmentReportRepository
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with wrong assignment reports in the database.

methods.name: existsByBookingUid
methods.description: Checks if a report exists for a given booking UID.

methods.name: createReport
methods.description: Creates a new wrong assignment report with provided input data.

methods.name: findTeamIdById
methods.description: Retrieves the team ID associated with a report by report ID.

methods.name: findByTeamIdsAndStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves reports filtered by team IDs, statuses, and optional routing form ID and reporter ID, with pagination.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status and reviewer info of a report by report ID.
